managedFilesPerConsumer.method: ai-native.lock.json + the entry points the adapters generate (CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json, opencode.json, .codex/config.toml). Plan SS15.1 (a) is a CLOSED list of 12; 7 of its entries are not implemented yet (bootstrap.ps1 was replaced by the node CLI, AGENTS.md kernel block, .claude/settings.json, the two caller workflows, the .gitignore block).

disclosure.note: agents, role profiles and lazy skill mirrors are regenerable from the lock by `adapters`; counted this way the figure is 20, ABOVE the target. Whether they are committed or gitignored is a consumer policy that is not enforced yet.

bytesCopiedPerConsumer.method: bytes of the committed managed set above vs the sum of tracked bytes of template-starter v2.0.4

bootstrapTimeWithCache.method: wall clock of `node runtime/bootstrap/cli.mjs sync --offline` (process start included) with a warm content-addressed cache

disclosure.note: includes a full verification of the cached release before use (PAR-CACHE-VERIFY-BEFORE-EXEC)

bootstrapTimeWithoutCache.method: wall clock of `sync --from-file <bundle> --offline` against an EMPTY cache: extract, hash every file, publish atomically

disclosure.note: excludes the network download of the release; that part is measured by pilot.yml online

networkCallsPerSessionWithCache.method: preloaded counter on fetch, http(s).request and net.connect while running status, sync --offline and doctor from a warm cache; every run must exit 0

disclosure.limit: a LOWER BOUND for the process tree: only in-process fetch/http(s)/net.connect are counted; child processes the CLI spawns (git, gh) are not instrumented. The offline paths spawn none that touch the network, but this counter alone does not prove it.

filesChangedByBump.method: applyBump on a git repo, git diff --name-only

contextAtReentryTokens.method: core/kernel.md + the frontmatter of every canonical skill; the estimate is chars/4, NOT a tokenizer count

capabilitiesCentralized.method: share of the 74 parity capabilities not classified LOCAL_BY_DESIGN

validationTimeLightVsFull.method: The metric is wall-clock validation time, dominated by model reviews that cannot be measured without spending model calls on every level; this records the structural ratio of steps and is NOT a time measurement.

hitlPerUnit.method: READ from core/security-policy.json (roles whose MERGE is allow) and contracts/state-machine.json (transitions into MERGED); the behaviour itself is proven by runtime/gates/gates.test.mjs (PAR-SINGLE-HITL)

circuitsPerMilestone.method: startWorkUnit(Milestone, 3 items) executed for real in a scratch repo; counts the milestone branches and run directories it creates
